prompt: Ritual preparation music at night, in the middle and upper registers: a slow steady Thai hand drum played on its skin with a dry tapping tone, small finger cymbals (ching) marking the beat, a long sustained line on a Thai reed oboe (pi), a bronze gong circle playing a slow figure; it gathers slowly, solemn and tense, building to the edge of something.
